title: Implement Core SSOT Database Schema
goal: Create the PostgreSQL database schema for the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) as defined in the architecture.

context.architecture_rule: Phone number is the Primary Key and Single Source of Truth.

sub_tasks.output: Prisma Schema file with all tables and relationships.
Migration script to apply schema to DB.

decisions: Use PostgreSQL for reliability and analytics.
Phone number (E.164) is the PK for contacts table.
acceptance_criteria: Indexes are added for performance on tenant_id and phone_number.
result_summary: Prisma schema created with SSOT (Contact + Interactions) and all relation tables.
